_note: Relics. Each effect key is summed across owned relics; see sim/run_state.gd mod().

blood_oath.name: Blood Oath
blood_oath.text: Heroes deal +4 damage. Hearth -30 max HP.

seed_cache.name: Seed Cache
seed_cache.text: +1 food per day for every round you have owned it.

bear_tooth_charm.name: Bear-tooth Charm
bear_tooth_charm.text: Heroes +10 max HP and retreat later.

fire_arrows.name: Fire Arrows
fire_arrows.text: Hearth and watch posts deal +4 damage.

sacred_spring.name: Sacred Spring
sacred_spring.text: Heroes heal fully between rounds and 3x faster at the hearth.

ember_stone.name: Ember Stone
ember_stone.text: The hearth burns 1 less fuel each night.

bone_dice.name: Bone Dice
bone_dice.text: Every kill drops +2 shells for the hero.
